storage: Keep in a cool, dry cupboard in the sealed pouch, or transfer opened noodles to an airtight box and use within a few weeks. Cooked noodles keep 1 to 2 days in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
looksLike: Thin, wavy, pale cream strands pressed into flat bricks, sold in 150 g pouches; the dish uses half a pouch (75 g).
howToPick: Look for intact, unbroken noodle bricks in a sealed pouch with a clear manufacture date; avoid pouches with crushed powder or an oily smell. Check the ingredient list for refined wheat flour and whether a seasoning sachet is included.
shelfLife: Usually several months from packing; follow the best-before date on the pouch (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Whole-wheat hakka noodles or atta noodles

usedIn.raw: 75 g per serving (half of a 150 g packet)
